title: Internet Message Access Protocol - Version 4rev1
summary: Defines IMAP4rev1, which lets a client access and manipulate email on a server. It allows mailboxes to be handled as if local, supports offline resynchronization, and includes operations to create, delete and rename mailboxes and check for new messages. It was replaced by RFC 9051.

eli5.summary: Instead of downloading your mail and deleting it from the server, IMAP lets you read and organize it where it is stored. It was later replaced by RFC 9051.
